limitations: No proof that all their models are affine; the arguments of Theorems 5-6 do not transfer directly because the z = 0 substitution produces 0*(yy) and 0*y terms.
statement: (xy)z = x(z(yy)) has the same anchored model counts as the golden law (xy)z = x(y(zz)), and (xy)z = x((zy)y) the same as the odd law (xy)z = x((yz)z), for N <= 9; their affine spectra coincide for N <= 40.
title: Mirror twins of the golden and odd laws
